headline: Megastar Foods discloses board meeting outcome
summary: Megastar Foods has submitted the outcome of its board meeting held on November 2, 2026, to the exchange. This is a routine compliance filing detailing corporate governance procedures. No financial results, dividends, or major corporate actions were disclosed in this summary notice. Indian retail investors holding the stock should check for subsequent detailed disclosures if any specific corporate action was discussed.
why_it_matters: No immediate financial impact on your holdings.
